newsitem.title: UK: EBRD says supports Czech Republic's reforms.
newsitem.headline: EBRD says supports Czech Republic's reforms.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said on Tuesday it recognised and supported recent policy reforms implemented by the Czech Republic.

"There has been full recognition of the importance of the corrective macroeconomic measures and policy reforms which the government has embarked upon, including expenditure control and stregnthening regulation in the capital markets," EBRD president Jacques de Larosiere said in a statement. Larosiere also said improvements in the investment climate in the Czech Republic were creating opportunities for investors.

"The EBRD will take a leading role in responding to this new environment, particularly through equity investments in the restructuring process as well as contributing to the development of capital markets."

In addition, the EBRD said Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus who addressed the bank's board of directors today in London emphasised the restructuring was necessary to underpin economic growth would have to come from committed high quality and long-term investments.
